Build the Foundation for Success: Why a BS Degree in Business Administration from CalMU Prepares You for the Future of Work

By George Altawil
June 6, 2025
 

In today’s fast-evolving workforce, a strong foundation in business is more than just an advantage — it’s a necessity. The Bachelor of Science in Business Administration (BSBA) at California Miramar University (CalMU) is designed to help students build the essential leadership, strategic thinking, and tech-forward management skills needed in nearly every industry.

CalMU’s BSBA is a 120-credit-hour program that can be completed in approximately four years and is offered at our San Diego, San Jose, and La Puente locations, or through flexible online formats. The curriculum blends traditional business principles with modern-day relevance, preparing students for a wide range of roles in leadership, operations, strategy, and technology.

Popular Career-Focused Concentrations:

  • Business Administration
  • Sports Management
  • Information Technology
  • Cybersecurity
  • Artificial Intelligence

Courses such as E-Commerce, Operations Management, Financial Management, Supply Chain, and Strategic Decision-Making give students the practical knowledge they need to navigate real-world business challenges. Meanwhile, specialized tracks like AI in Business or Cybersecurity Management reflect the increasing demand for digital fluency in executive decision-making roles.

With tuition estimated at $12,192 per year, CalMU remains an affordable choice for students who want a high-impact degree without a high cost. Small class sizes and experienced faculty ensure personalized support throughout the journey — whether students are entering the workforce for the first time or returning to finish a degree.

According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, overall employment in business and financial occupations is projected to grow faster than the average for all occupations from 2023 to 2033. Each year, an estimated 963,500 openings are projected on average, reflecting both new job creation and replacement needs.

At CalMU, we don’t just teach business — we teach leadership, innovation, and adaptability. With a mix of classroom instruction, case-based learning, and capstone projects, students graduate ready to contribute immediately in their chosen fields. Take the next step toward a career in business that makes an impact.
